# awesome-local-ai

> A curated list of AI tools that run entirely on local hardware without cloud dependencies or telemetry.

The project is a maintained index of software for inference, voice, image generation, and local agents. It includes inclusion rules requiring verifiable provenance and strict local inference, with entries categorized by platform and license.

## Docs

- [awesome-local-ai](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/main/README.md): Curated list of fully local AI tools with strict inclusion rules and verified links.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Strict rule requiring inference on owned hardware without transmitting data off-device during normal use.
- [Inclusion rules](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#inclusion-rules): Requirements for local hardware execution, verifiable provenance, and installable artifacts, plus maintenance and removal policies.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#legend): Icons indicating operating systems, source availability, pricing, programming languages, and recent listing status.
- [Inference Runtimes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#inference-runtimes): Engines for running LLMs and neural networks locally, including llama.cpp, ExLlamaV3, and llamafile.
- [Desktop Chat Apps](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#desktop-chat-apps): GUI applications wrapping local runtimes in chat interfaces, such as Anything LLM and Open WebUI.
- [Voice — Speech-to-Text](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#voice--speech-to-text): Offline speech-to-text tools like Brethof Voice Pro, Buzz, Dictámelo, and faster-whisper for transcription and translation.
- [Voice — Text-to-Speech](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#voice--text-to-speech): Local text-to-speech engines including Chatterbox, Coqui TTS, Kokoro, Kyutai Pocket TTS, Piper, and VoxCPM2.
- [Image Generation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#image-generation): Local image generation interfaces such as ComfyUI, Forge, InvokeAI, Mold, Radiant Canvas, and SD.Next.
- [Video Generation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#video-generation): Local video generation tools including ComfyUI with LTX Video, NanoAvatar, and WanGP for consumer hardware.
- [Code Assistants](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#code-assistants): Local code assistants like Aider, Cline, Llama.vim, Tabby, and twinny for terminal and IDE integration.
- [Local Agents](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#local-agents): Local AI agents including Aider architect mode, goose, Hyperconsciousness, Open Interpreter, and Tree Ring Memory.
- [Vector Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#vector-databases): Chroma, Faiss, LanceDB, Qdrant, sqlite-vec, and Weaviate for local vector storage and similarity search.
- [Embeddings](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#embeddings): BGE, fastembed, and Sentence Transformers for generating local text embeddings on CPU or GPU.
- [Training & Fine-tuning](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#training--fine-tuning): AI Toolkit, Axolotl, diffusion-pipe, MLX, and Unsloth for training and fine-tuning local AI models.
- [Local Search & RAG](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#local-search--rag): Anything LLM, LlamaIndex, PrivateGPT, SearXNG, and Vane for local search and RAG pipelines.
- [Operating Systems Tuned for AI](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#operating-systems-tuned-for-ai): CachyOS and Pop!_OS, two Linux distributions tuned for local AI and GPU driver support.
- [Hardware-Specific Runtimes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#hardware-specific-runtimes): Lemonade, MLX LM, TensorRT-LLM, OpenVINO, and ROCm runtimes for specific hardware architectures.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-local-ai/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Links to related projects covering llms.txt tools, privacy AI, MCP servers, licenses, Linux distros, and ComfyUI workflows.
